title: Lemon Cake and Sharp Eyes  (Pastel de limón y vista aguda)

segments.t: Afuera en el patio, Tessa sirve un plato de pastel tibio de limón para Owen y Caleb. Entre bocado y bocado, el observador hermano mayor mira hacia la ventana del vestíbulo. Escuchemos primero.
Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake with extra corner pieces!
One bite... Caleb, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!
Tessa baked it this morning when Miss Evelyn told her our Friday story.
What kind of magical guesthouse did you walk into, little brother?
The kind that fixes attic lamps in the rain and guards a stranger's bag.
Then tell me why the poor gentleman behind the front desk looks ready to cry.
Oh! Did you see Arthur through the window? I tried to smile twice as wide!
Tessa, is something wrong inside? Did the boiler break again?
Worse than a pipe... a registered letter came from the building owner at noon.
A property letter? Let Caleb and me see it. I work in city contracts, and he knows heritage law!
Wait, Owen, you still work at City Hall's contract desk?!
Both of you?! Leave your teacups, come inside this very second!
Ahora recorramos cada línea paso a paso.
Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake with extra corner pieces!
'Recién salido del horno: ¡pastel de limón de los viernes con trozos extra de esquina!'
One bite... Caleb, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!
'Un bocado... Caleb, ¡cierra los ojos! ¡Sabe exactamente igual que la tarta del abuelo!'
Tessa baked it this morning when Miss Evelyn told her our Friday story.
'Tessa lo horneó esta mañana cuando la señorita Evelyn le contó nuestra historia de los viernes.'
What kind of magical guesthouse did you walk into, little brother?
'¿En qué clase de posada mágica te metiste, hermanito?'
The kind that fixes attic lamps in the rain and guards a stranger's bag.
'De la clase que arregla lámparas del ático bajo la lluvia y guarda la maleta de un desconocido.'
Then tell me why the poor gentleman behind the front desk looks ready to cry.
'Entonces dime por qué el pobre caballero detrás de la recepción parece a punto de llorar.'
Oh! Did you see Arthur through the window? I tried to smile twice as wide!
'¡Oh! ¿Vio a Arthur por la ventana? ¡Intenté sonreír el doble de ancho!'
Tessa, is something wrong inside? Did the boiler break again?
'Tessa, ¿pasa algo malo dentro? ¿Se volvió a romper la caldera?'
Worse than a pipe... a registered letter came from the building owner at noon.
'Peor que una tubería... al mediodía llegó una carta certificada del dueño del edificio.'
A property letter? Let Caleb and me see it. I work in city contracts, and he knows heritage law!
'¿Una carta inmobiliaria? Déjanos verla a Caleb y a mí. ¡Yo trabajo en contratos municipales y él sabe de ley de patrimonio!'
Wait, Owen, you still work at City Hall's contract desk?!
'¡Espera, Owen, ¿sigues trabajando en la mesa de contratos del Ayuntamiento?!'
Both of you?! Leave your teacups, come inside this very second!
'¡¿Los dos?! ¡Dejen sus tazas de té, entren ahora mismo en este preciso segundo!'
Volvamos a escuchar toda la escena a velocidad normal.

Tessa, is something wrong inside? Did the boiler break again?
Worse than a pipe... a registered letter came from the building owner at noon.
A property letter? Let Caleb and me see it. I work in city contracts, and he knows heritage law!
Wait, Owen, you still work at City Hall's contract desk?!
Both of you?! Leave your teacups, come inside this very second!
No solo Caleb es arquitecto de patios históricos: ¡Owen trabaja en la oficina de contratos municipales del Ayuntamiento! Entremos deprisa a la recepción en la próxima escena.
See you soon!
